This is a list of grammar rules you need to study for the Japanese Language Proficiency Test level N5.






Click here
to download JLPT N5 Grammar List (printable PDF file).


Click on each grammar point for more details.


Verb Conjugation


だ / です (da / desu)
: to be (copula)


だけ (dake)
: only, just


だろう (darou)
: probably


で (de) – 1
: at, in


で (de) – 2
: with, by


でしょう (deshou)
: I think, probably


が (ga) – 1
: subject marker


が (ga) – 2
: but, however


がある (gaaru)
: there is (used for non-living things)


がいる (gairu)
: there is (used for living things)
